thread:
anna: Heads up 1 DeepForge Labs wants a joint demo + marketplace bundle next week. Theyre running a custom edge box and want LangChain -> LlamaIndex ingestion -> our gateway -> Dedicated. Can we scope?

rafael: I can run the adapter tests for LangChain + LlamaIndex. Quick check: do they plan to use our streaming API or the non-stream generation path? That changes the demo wiring.

emily: Theyre aiming for streaming to show low-latency edge-to-cloud. Ill coordinate demo UX and the sequence of calls we show. Need Rafaels smoke tests before we finalize the script.

tom: Ops note: DeepForges device images terminate TLS with an intermediary cert chain. Ops needs their staging cert bundle to avoid MITM on our side. If not, we can add a TLS proxy in front of the gateway for the demo. Also need a 1-hour Dedicated maintenance window to apply a routing tweak. Prefer Tue 01:30-02:30 UTC.

rafael: Got it. Ill validate end-to-end flows and add a tiny change to the LlamaIndex vector path to namespace tenant keys. Proposed snippet to avoid collisions: ```python
# namespace vector store keys per tenant
def lindex_key(tenant, qid):
    return f"df:{tenant}:vid:{qid}"
```

jen: Marketing/legal: we need an NDA clause for joint announcements and a short MKT checklist. Legal-bot - do we have a standard co-announcement template?

legal-bot: filing COANN-0921 for review. Standard co-announcement template attached to ticket. Please allow 48-72 hours for sign-off.

emily: Timeline suggestion: Mon - Rafael smoke test results; Tue small gateway push + maintenance (Tom); Wed 10:00 internal dry run; Wed 15:00 partner demo. If legal needs more time, shift announcement but keep demo internal.

anna: Action owners: Rafael -> adapter tests & LlamaIndex tweak, Tom -> cert/proxy + maintenance window, Emily -> demo script + slides, Jen -> co-announcement draft + coordinate legal. Ill sync with DeepForge PM for exact times.

rafael: Ill also run an automation check for tool-calling with LangChain using streaming. Quick curl for streaming connect (local dev): ```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" 
  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-stream-1","input":"call tool:extract_entities"}'
```

tom: Ops will stand by for rollback: revert gateway change and re-route traffic to fallback model if routing errors > 1% in 5 minutes. Ill post runbook steps here once maintenance is scheduled.

jen: Drafting co-branded slide deck and vendor brief. Will post draft by Tue 12:00 UTC.

legal-bot: COANN-0921 created and assigned to @jen for initial fill. Reminder: no marketplace listing until legal signs the co-marketing addendum.

anna: Thanks team. Keep updates compact in this thread. If blockers arise, flag immediately and well push the schedule. :white_check_mark:
